doctor.bio_short: Dr. Camenzuli has spent 25 years building the clinical capability to help patients who would otherwise avoid care entirely. His mother lost all her teeth by age 16 to untreated dental fear — that experience drove three fellowships, IV sedation licensure, and advanced implant protocols. He treats the full scope of dental care in-house, without the referrals and fragmented experience most general practices require.
